items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She told me about Jimmy and that’s when I first heard of him

ctx.x: An earlier account stated that your mom gave you the choice to either take voice lessons or piano lessons. How old were you when she offered you that choice?

Well I was in basically junior high school at the time . . . I think I was in junior high (laughs). Yeah because here’s what happened, in the junior high school there was a lady there who actually became Jimmy Smith’s wife. She told me about Jimmy and that’s when I first heard of him . . . organ player and whatever.
